D: A team of supervillains is dropped onto the island of Corto Maltese on a mission that goes very wrong.
P: Serve the snacks when the squad cuts loose in a Corto Maltese bar.
S: Baked beef empanadas with cumin and green olives.
Beef mince cooked with onion, cumin and chopped olives, folded into pastry rounds, crimped and baked at 200C for 20 minutes, with chimichurri.
Bocconcini, cherry tomato and basil on toothpicks, balsamic dots.
Bocconcini, cherry tomatoes and basil threaded onto toothpicks, drizzled with olive oil and dots of thick balsamic.
Red beans simmered soft with onion, celery and pepper, spooned over white rice.

Soften the onion, celery, capsicum and garlic in a little oil. Stir in the Cajun seasoning. Add the beans and stock and simmer, mashing a few beans to thicken. Season. Cook the rice while the beans simmer. Spoon the beans over the rice in small bowls.
M: Grilled lime and chilli chicken thighs, long grain rice and black beans.
Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, grilled until charred, served with rice and black beans and a fresh salsa.
Chicken, smoked sausage and rice cooked in one pot with peppers and Cajun spice.

Brown the chicken and sausage in a big pot and set aside. Soften the onion, capsicum and celery in the same pot, then stir in the Cajun seasoning. Add the rice and stir to coat. Add the tomatoes, stock, chicken and sausage, cover and simmer until the rice is tender. Season.
W: Buttery starfish cookies in pink and blue, for Starro the Conqueror.
Shortbread dough rolled and cut into starfish shapes, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, iced pink and blue with white dots.
K: Mango, coconut milk and lime blended with crushed ice.
Blended mango, coconut milk and lime over ice, with cachaça or white rum for adults.

note.text: If I die because I gambled on love, it will be a worthy death.

s.note: Small shrimp fried crisp in a cornmeal coat. King Shark says nom nom.

d.n: Iced sweet tea from the urn
d.note: Black tea brewed strong, sugared and poured over ice.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and crimp the empanadas up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge, and bake on the night; chimichurri up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Dice the onion and chop the olives.
Brown the mince with onion and cumin, stir in the olives and cool.
Cut pastry into rounds, fill, fold and crimp.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Blitz parsley, garlic, vinegar and oil for chimichurri.

veg.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead, fill and crimp up to 1 day ahead and bake on the night; chimichurri up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Dice the onion and chop the olives.
Brown the plant-based mince with the onion, cumin and a splash of the oil, stir in the olives and cool.
Cut pastry into rounds, fill, fold and crimp.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Blitz parsley, garlic, vinegar and the rest of the oil for chimichurri.

dishes.make_ahead: Reduce the balsamic up to 1 week ahead; thread the skewers and drizzle on the day

steps.text: Reduce the balsamic in a small pan until syrupy and cool.
Thread bocconcini, tomatoes and basil onto toothpicks.
Lay on a white platter and drizzle with oil.
Dot the balsamic all over the plate.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken in the lime, garlic and chilli up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill and make the salsa on the night

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped chilli and salt.
Leave to marinate.
Cook the rice and warm the drained beans.
Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.
Make a salsa of diced tomato, red onion and lime.

veg.make_ahead: Toss the haloumi in the marinade up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; grill and make the salsa on the night

steps.text: Toss the haloumi in the oil, the juice of two limes, crushed garlic and chopped chilli.
Leave to marinate.
Cook the rice and warm the drained beans.
Grill the haloumi until charred on both sides.
Make a salsa of diced tomato, red onion, the last lime and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar, then mix in the flour.
Roll out and cut into starfish shapes.
Bake at 160C.
Cool completely.
Ice pink and blue with icing sugar, colouring and a little water, and pipe white dots along each arm.

dishes.make_ahead: Peel and chop the mangoes and juice the limes up to 1 day ahead, chilled; blend with ice and add the rum just before serving

steps.text: Peel the mangoes and juice the limes.
Blend the mango, coconut milk, lime juice, sugar and ice until smooth.
Pour into four glasses and add a measure of rum to the adult glasses only.

af.make_ahead: Peel and chop the mangoes and juice the limes up to 1 day ahead, chilled; blend with ice and vanilla just before serving

steps.text: Peel the mangoes and juice the limes.
Blend the mango, coconut milk, lime juice, sugar, vanilla and ice until smooth.
Pour into four glasses.

Corto Maltese empanadas.veg: Baked veggie mince empanadas with cumin and green olives.

Jungle mission chicken.veg: Grilled lime and chilli halloumi, long grain rice and black beans.

Mango and coconut cooler.af: Mango, coconut milk and lime blended with ice.

Belle Reve jambalaya.veg: Leave out the chicken and sausage; use smoked tofu and vegetable stock.

s.note: Baked beef empanadas with cumin and green olives.
s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion and a teaspoon of cumin, then stir in chopped green olives. Cut shortcrust into rounds, fill, fold and crimp. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Blitz parsley with garlic, vinegar and oil for chimichurri.

s.note: Bocconcini, cherry tomato and basil on toothpicks, balsamic dots.
s.how: Thread bocconcini, cherry tomatoes and basil leaves onto toothpicks. Lay on a white platter and drizzle with olive oil. Reduce balsamic vinegar until syrupy and dot it all over the plate in polka dots. Do not look at your mother.

m.note: Grilled lime and chilli chicken thighs, long grain rice and black beans.
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped red chilli and salt for an hour. Grill until charred. Serve with long grain rice, warm black beans and a quick fresh salsa of tomato, onion and lime.

w.note: Buttery starfish cookies in pink and blue, for Starro the Conqueror.
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g sugar, then mix in 350g flour. Roll out and cut into starfish shapes. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Cool, then ice pink and blue with icing sugar and colouring, and pipe little white dots along each arm.

d.note: Mango, coconut milk and lime blended with crushed ice.
d.how: Blend 2 mangoes, 200ml coconut milk, the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp sugar and 2 cups ice until smooth. Pour into 4 glasses, adding 30ml white rum to adult glasses.
